name: Assistant exam
what: Puts 20 fixed real questions to the live agent once a day and a fresh sample of 20 unseen ones (from a pool of 100+) three times a day, scores the answers on correctness, usefulness and clarity with pattern checks and a blind model judge, logs each score, and puts the weak areas on the build list.
schedule: with the house lanes at 09:00, 13:00, 19:00 UTC
